# FindUSlaw Bookstore

> > Legal bookstore offering specialized titles on court rules, legal history, criminal law, estate planning, and judicial ethics.

FindUSlaw Bookstore provides a curated collection of legal publications ranging from practical guides like Michigan Court Rules and estate planning handbooks to scholarly works on legal philosophy, historical legal cases including the JFK assassination analysis, and professional resources for law students and practitioners.

## Key Topics

- Legal History
- Criminal Law
- Estate Planning
- Judicial Ethics
- JFK Assassination
- Michigan Court Rules
- Legal Philosophy
- Court Procedures
- Legal Education
- Constitutional Law
- Reconstruction Era
- Workers' Compensation Law
- Natural Rights Theory
- Trial Practice

## Legal Practice Guides

- [Michigan Court Rules; 2023 Edition - Paperback](https://finduslaw.com/products/michigan-court-rules-2023-edition-paperback): 2023 Michigan Court Rules reference by Michigan Legal Publishing Ltd
- [Write Fast Legal Memos Like a Sport(tm) - Paperback](https://finduslaw.com/products/write-fast-legal-memos-like-a-sporttm-paperback): Legal memo writing guide for bar exam and practice by Mary Gallagher
- [How to Get a Fair Trial by Jury - Paperback](https://finduslaw.com/products/how-to-get-a-fair-trial-by-jury-paperback): Jury selection guide by NY Supreme Court Justice Randolph Jackson
- [The Law School Bible - Paperback](https://finduslaw.com/products/the-law-school-bible-paperback): Alternative legal education guide by Peter J. Loughlin

## Estate Planning and Administration

- [Entrusted: Building a Legacy That Lasts - Hardcover](https://finduslaw.com/products/entrusted-building-a-legacy-that-lasts-hardcover): Estate planning and legacy building guide by Howell and York
- [Estate Planning in Florida - A Concise and Complete Guide to Peace of Mind - Paperback](https://finduslaw.com/products/estate-planning-in-florida-a-concise-and-complete-guide-to-peace-of-mind-paperback): Florida estate planning guide by Dean Hanewinckel

## Criminal Law and Famous Cases

- [Impossible: The Case Against Lee Harvey Oswald (Volume Two) - Paperback](https://finduslaw.com/products/impossible-the-case-against-lee-harvey-oswald-volume-two-paperback): JFK assassination analysis examining Oswald case by Barry Krusch
- [Impossible: The Case Against Lee Harvey Oswald (Volume Three) - Paperback](https://finduslaw.com/products/impossible-the-case-against-lee-harvey-oswald-volume-three-paperback): JFK assassination analysis Volume 3 by Barry Krusch
- [Math on Trial: How Numbers Get Used and Abused in the Courtroom - Hardcover](https://finduslaw.com/products/math-on-trial-how-numbers-get-used-and-abused-in-the-courtroom-hardcover): Mathematics and statistics in legal cases by Schneps and Colmez
- [The Bureau and the Mole: The Unmasking of Robert Philip Hanssen - Paperback](https://finduslaw.com/products/the-bureau-and-the-mole-the-unmasking-of-robert-philip-hanssen-the-most-dangerous-double-agent-in-fbi-history-paperback): FBI double agent Robert Hanssen espionage case by David A. Vise

## American Legal History

- [The Day Freedom Died: The Colfax Massacre, the Supreme Court, and the Betrayal of Reconstruction - Paperback](https://finduslaw.com/products/the-day-freedom-died-the-colfax-massacre-the-supreme-court-and-the-betrayal-of-reconstruction-paperback): Reconstruction-era legal history of Colfax Massacre by Charles Lane
- [Justice Accused: Antislavery and the Judicial Process - Paperback](https://finduslaw.com/products/justice-accused-antislavery-and-the-judicial-process-paperback): 19th-century judicial ethics and slavery by Robert M. Cover
- [The Accidental Republic: Crippled Workingmen, Destitute Widows, and the Remaking of American Law - Paperback](https://finduslaw.com/products/the-accidental-republic-crippled-workingmen-destitute-widows-and-the-remaking-of-american-law-paperback): Post-Civil War tort and workers' compensation law by John Fabian Witt
- [Pullman Case - Paperback](https://finduslaw.com/products/pullman-case-paperback): 1894 Pullman Strike and Eugene Debs case by David Ray Papke

## Legal Philosophy and Theory

- [The Responsible Judge: Readings in Judicial Ethics - Paperback](https://finduslaw.com/products/the-responsible-judge-readings-in-judicial-ethics-paperback): Judicial ethics anthology edited by Noonan and Winston
- [Law, Justice, and Power: Between Reason and Will - Paperback](https://finduslaw.com/products/law-justice-and-power-between-reason-and-will-paperback): Legal theory anthology on law, justice, and power edited by Cheng
- [Natural Rights Theories: Their Origin and Development - Paperback](https://finduslaw.com/products/natural-rights-theories-their-origin-and-development-paperback): Medieval to Enlightenment natural rights history by Richard Tuck
- [The Spirit of Roman Law - Paperback](https://finduslaw.com/products/the-spirit-of-roman-law-paperback): Roman law philosophy and values by Alan Watson

## Optional

- [The Expulsion Hearing: An Administrative Guide - Paperback](https://finduslaw.com/products/the-expulsion-hearing-an-administrative-guide-paperback): Student expulsion hearing procedures by Michael Mackniak
- [Phyllis Schlafly Speaks, Volume 2: On Donald Trump - Paperback](https://finduslaw.com/products/phyllis-schlafly-speaks-volume-2-on-donald-trump-paperback): Phyllis Schlafly's endorsement and views on Donald Trump
